A world selector is a NAMED, REUSABLE MATCHER: 'Names' is the vocabulary this file
contributes, and 'Match'/'GameplayConfig' are the patterns a world must satisfy to earn
it. Match takes the world-name grammar Foo (exact), Foo* (prefix), *Foo (suffix), *Foo*
(contains) and * (everything); only the *Foo* form reaches a live instance world, whose
'default' is the stock name of a fresh Hytale world. If your server's main world is named
something else, ADD it here rather than replacing this line, e.g.
Two files may contribute to one name and both apply, so a mod can widen 'primary' by
shipping its own file listing the same name - the filename is only an address, never a
meaning. Override this exact file by dropping a Zc_Primary.json of your own in a later
pack or in the owner layer.
Watch out: a name nothing matches is silent. If content bound to 'primary' never appears,
check that your world's real name is listed here.
